origin: Retained STS2_ML source and evaluation archive; paths below are relative to that archive, not bundled dependencies.
adaptations: schema.py preserves exact 16-card/24-global field order and exhaust threshold 3.

encoding.py adapts the original calculations to named buffs and per-instance card programs/flags in four visible owned piles. Native adapter, non-pile nodes, simulator and neural network are not packaged.
Known-top, known-bottom and unknown draw members are combined only for membership/count calculations; no hidden order is supplied.

Examples use eleven ordinary unupgraded source programs and nine hand-authored states. They are illustrative, not simulator trajectories. Expected outputs were computed using the retained source calculation.
Results extract all 32 completed checkpoints; the previous comparison is the best pooled-boss point from the already-published lethality arm. No new evaluations, checkpoint loads, or figures.
Growth counters and probability work are outside this experimentally evaluated v1 snapshot.
